crossRefs.note: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.
He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
and said, “I beg you, Yahweh, the God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with…
I prayed to Yahweh my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and…
to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them…
